note: Hua'er is mostly sung live at mountain festivals and sold on local discs in China; the Naxos field album of Qinghai and Gansu singers is the easiest way in.

size.basis: Repertoire is large (over a hundred ling tunes in the Hehuang area, over a hundred annual festivals, national inheritors such as 朱仲禄, 马金山, 马俊), and regional cassettes and discs circulate in the northwest, but almost none of it is catalogued: one internationally issued field album (Naxos World 2019, 46 tracks across five peoples, only some of them hua'er) and scattered tracks by trained singers (苏平, 朱仲禄, 龚琳娜) on mainland releases. Range is a rough guess at issued, findable hua'er tracks, not a catalogue count.
